title: Update on Singapore Islamic College and Postgraduate Certificate in Islam in Contemporary Societies Programme
what_it_is: Update on Singapore Islamic College and Postgraduate Certificate in Islam in Contemporary Societies Programme

sections.label: PCICS programme and MUIS improvements
sections.summary: The one-year PCICS programme enrolled 132 returning religious graduates across three cohorts, and MUIS will improve language support and applied learning.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The one-year programme has since enrolled three cohorts for a total of 132 returning religious graduates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The joint academic committee, comprising senior Majlis Ugama Islam Singapura (MUIS) representatives and faculty members from the University partners, namely National University of Singapore, Singapore University of Social Sciences, Al Azhar University and University of Jordan, observed that the first PCICS cohort performed well despite the challenge of the COVID-19 pandemic.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Based on feedback from the first cohort of students, 70% felt that learning outcomes across modules were achieved and they reported a positive learning experience.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: MUIS will be making several improvements to the PCICS.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: These include strengthening English and Arabic language support for students and introducing more opportunities for practical applied learning so that students can have more hands-on experiences before they enter the workforce.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The first cohort of PCICS students will be graduating this year and MUIS will continue to engage them to assess how the PCICS has helped prepare them for employment as asatizah.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The PCICS is an important precursor to our longer-term plan to establish a tertiary level institution of Islamic studies.

sections.label: Participants contributing ideas and content
sections.summary: 1,900 participants contributed to the ideas and content.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: In fact, we got 1,900 participants to contribute to the ideas, content and so forth.

sections.label: Reviewing first PCICS run
sections.summary: The first PCICS run will be reviewed, considering community outcomes and students' interests and future.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Being the first run of the PCICS this year, we will definitely have to review and look at what will be best for our community, the outcomes of the PCICS as well as take in the interests of the students and their future.
